text:
Situation: Ketamine hydrochloride inventory varies across sites. Corvale East holds three presentations totaling 180 vials with 5.4 to 9.5 days on hand. Corvale General holds three lots totaling 499.4 units with 16.4 to 25.1 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 15 vials with 7.2 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists ketamine hydrochloride as To Be Discontinued since 2018-02-16.

Our position: Current stock supports limited operations. Corvale General can support internal transfers to East and Lakeside while maintaining a two-week buffer. Three manufacturers not on FDA’s shortage list today are available for purchase.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 15 vials from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 143 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC — approved by buyer.
4. Purchase from Par Health USA, LLC — approved by buyer.
5. Purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
